name: Base
description: Project design authority. Empty until conventions are established.

policy.on_undefined: No convention is recorded yet. Decide deliberately; prefer the project's nearest consistent pieces; file a gap with the need, the fallback used and evidence.
policy.on_conflict: A recorded convention constrains this request. Reconcile with the record; do not build the contradiction.
policy.proposals: Proposals are nonbinding precedent; they live in the workspace records and never override the authority.
